# portainer_edge_group (Data Source)

The `portainer_edge_group` data source allows you to look up an existing Portainer Edge group by its name.

## Example Usage

### Look up an Edge group by name

```hcl
data "portainer_edge_group" "retail_stores" {
  name = "Retail-Stores"
}

output "edge_group_id" {
  value = data.portainer_edge_group.retail_stores.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the edge group to look up in Portainer.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Whether the edge group is dynamic (membership computed from tags) or static (explicit endpoint list).
- `id` (String) Identifier of the edge group.
